rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: Care needs assessments are for adults aged 18 and over. Contact children's services if you need support for someone under 18.

rules.description: Applicant must be ordinarily resident in the local authority area
rules.reason_if_failed: You need to apply to the local authority where you live. We will help you identify the correct local authority.

rules.description: Applicant indicates they have difficulty with daily activities or personal care
rules.reason_if_failed: Care needs assessments are for people who need support with daily living. If you're looking for other services, we can signpost you.

explanation_template: Care needs assessment eligibility: {outcome}. Any adult can request an assessment if they appear to have care needs.

edge_cases.description: Applicant or assessor identifies immediate safeguarding risk (abuse, neglect, exploitation)
edge_cases.action: Immediate handoff to safeguarding team. Assessment paused pending safeguarding investigation. Urgent response within 24 hours.

edge_cases.description: Applicant may lack mental capacity to consent to assessment or make care decisions
edge_cases.action: Mental Capacity Act assessment required. Independent advocate may be needed. Family member or attorney involvement required.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is being discharged from hospital and needs fast-track assessment
edge_cases.action: Fast-track pathway. Assessment must begin within 24 hours to prevent delayed discharge.

edge_cases.description: Applicant's informal carer is unable to continue caring
edge_cases.action: Urgent assessment required. Parallel carer's assessment may be needed. Temporary care arrangements may be necessary.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a terminal diagnosis and needs end-of-life care planning
edge_cases.action: Fast-track continuing healthcare assessment may be appropriate. Palliative care team involvement.
